$description: Connected applications (#114 item 5; plan ~/handoff/decisions/273-plan.md). Every release scans the ones it can reach, read-only (tools/baseline/drift.mjs), and lists per app 'at baseline' or 'N items to fix'. A release never fails because of an app. channel: how the app picks its Plenix version. Add an app by PR (pds1-release-architect).

apps.name: ctm
apps.title: CTM
apps.channel: cdn/latest.json (held by pins.ctm when set; checks every 30 minutes, and at once on the plenix-release event)

notify.decision: D-0082, #750: sent after the live check by tools/publish/notify-apps.mjs

apps.name: st-john
apps.title: St. John the Beloved site
apps.channel: pinned CDN version, with its own icon file (plenix-icons-st-john.js)

apps.name: suite
apps.title: The suite (dashboard, projects, files, ...)
apps.channel: source: built from this repository, always the current Plenix
apps.reason: it is part of this repository; check-system and check-style hold it to the baseline on every PR

apps.name: aiteam
apps.title: AITEAM
apps.channel: pinned CDN version (0.73.0 when last seen), with integrity hashes
apps.reason: its repository is not reachable from here; its maintainer runs tools/baseline/scan.js

apps.name: redsave
apps.title: RedSave (browser extension)
apps.channel: pinned CDN version (0.69.4 when last seen), self-hosted from the archive; it changes only when its owner moves the pin
apps.reason: the repository is private, so CI can't clone it; before a release that removes classes, the Release Architect runs tools/publish/removed-in-apps.mjs's scan on it from the agent host (#125; 2026-11-06: none of the 311 used)
